scope: Curated public data and references; no claim of exhaustive coverage or end-to-end download verification.

sources.title: Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data
sources.project_use: Official challenge and final authority for the NASA submission.
sources.caveat: Indexed official description found; the full page and Resources tab could not be fetched during this review.

sources.title: Field Shift challenge and resource-list mirror
sources.project_use: Readable event-host copy for navigation when the official page is unavailable.
sources.caveat: Secondary source, used only to cross-reference the challenge list. NASA remains authoritative. HLS and FIRMS are not separately named in this copy.

sources.title: Transavia sustainability reports
sources.project_use: Company context, supply-chain boundaries and published sustainability reporting.
sources.caveat: Company-level figures are not ingredient-specific emission factors or supplier commitments.

sources.title: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 data products
sources.project_use: Field-scale vegetation monitoring; surface reflectance and HLS-VI indices.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for the standard download workflow
sources.caveat: Use a consistent collection and cloud/quality masks. Frequent overpasses do not guarantee cloud-free observations.

sources.title: MODIS Terra vegetation indices
sources.project_use: NDVI/EVI time series for historical vegetation comparisons.
sources.access: Public catalogue; Earthdata authentication for data downloads
sources.caveat: Apply quality flags, fill-value handling and the documented scale factor. Pixels can mix multiple fields/crops.

sources.title: SMAP L3 radiometer soil moisture, Version 9
sources.project_use: Daily surface-soil moisture context.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for standard downloads
sources.caveat: Regional context; a grid value is not a measurement of an individual small farm.

sources.title: SMAP Enhanced L3 soil moisture, Version 6
sources.project_use: Enhanced surface-soil moisture product.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for standard downloads
sources.caveat: Enhanced grid spacing is not equivalent to independent field-scale detail.

sources.title: SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture, Version 8
sources.project_use: Model-assimilated surface and root-zone moisture for regional water-stress assessment.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for standard downloads
sources.caveat: Provider notice: L4 data for 14 May–28 July 2026 are being reprocessed after a geolocation issue. Check processing status if those dates are used; record version and retrieval date.

sources.title: GPM precipitation data directory
sources.project_use: Rainfall totals, timing and anomalies; links to half-hourly and daily IMERG products.
sources.access: Public directory; Earthdata for GES DISC, separate registration for PPS routes
sources.caveat: Record Early/Late/Final run. Final is delayed. Distinguish precipitation rate from accumulated depth.

sources.title: NASA POWER Daily API
sources.project_use: Temperature, precipitation and solar-radiation time series for the selected location.
sources.access: Public API; no Earthdata login required
sources.resolution: Daily; spatial resolution depends on source parameter
sources.caveat: Choose the agroclimatology community and record units/time standard. These are gridded data, not a field weather station; start dates differ by parameter.

sources.title: ECOSTRESS tiled evapotranspiration, Version 3
sources.project_use: Evapotranspiration estimates for spatial water-use comparisons.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for standard downloads
sources.caveat: Keep model/layer, time basis, uncertainty and cloud flags. Do not treat irregular scenes as an uninterrupted daily record.

sources.title: ECOSTRESS tiled evaporative stress index, Version 3
sources.project_use: Water-stress context from actual-to-potential evapotranspiration.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earthdata authentication for standard downloads
sources.caveat: Interpret the product-specific ESI definition and flags; verify historical coverage before promising five years of valid observations.

sources.title: ECOSTRESS data access
sources.project_use: Entry points to Earthdata, AppEEARS and ECOSTRESS documentation.
sources.caveat: Mission pages and catalogue pages can update at different times; pin the exact downloaded product version.

sources.title: FIRMS active-fire downloads
sources.project_use: Optional active-fire/hotspot evidence near crop-sourcing areas.
sources.access: Public recent-data downloads; archive access follows provider workflow
sources.caveat: A thermal detection alone does not establish agricultural burning or burned area.

sources.title: FIRMS area API
sources.project_use: Programmatic fire detections for a bounding box and time window.
sources.caveat: Keep the key outside Git. API limits and archive availability depend on the selected source.

sources.title: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
sources.project_use: Optional long-term climate scenarios for rotation resilience.
sources.access: Public documentation and documented THREDDS/AWS routes
sources.caveat: Climate projections are not next-season weather forecasts; retain model, experiment, realization and version.

sources.title: Earthdata Search
sources.project_use: Locate collections and files by product, area and date.
sources.access: JavaScript app; Earthdata login for many downloads

sources.title: AppEEARS API documentation
sources.project_use: Point/area extraction workflows and current supported-product catalogue.
sources.access: Public documentation; account authentication for user tasks
sources.caveat: Confirm product/version support in the catalogue; do not assume all products in this folder are supported.

sources.title: Common Metadata Repository Search API
sources.project_use: Discover exact collection identifiers, granules, metadata and data links.
sources.access: Public metadata API; file download authorization is separate

sources.title: NASA Worldview
sources.project_use: Visual checks and map illustrations.
sources.caveat: A rendered map image is not a substitute for numeric analysis data.

sources.title: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
sources.project_use: Supplementary Sentinel imagery and data-access documentation.
sources.access: Public documentation; separate Copernicus account for relevant services
sources.caveat: Earthdata credentials do not automatically grant access to Copernicus services.

sources.title: SoilGrids
sources.project_use: Baseline soil organic carbon, pH and texture with prediction uncertainty.
sources.caveat: Static modelled soil properties do not measure the annual effect of a proposed rotation.

sources.title: SoilGrids access documentation
sources.project_use: WCS/WebDAV alternatives and access limitations.
sources.caveat: REST API is reported paused as of this review. Use documented alternative routes; their full download workflows were not tested.

sources.title: SoilGrids raster directory
sources.project_use: VRT mosaics and GeoTIFF tiles for local processing.
sources.caveat: Record the actual release behind latest and subset the area; whole-world layers are large.

sources.title: LUCAS 2018 topsoil data
sources.project_use: Ground-sample soil context and independent comparison with modelled soils.
sources.caveat: Sparse points are not parcel-wide measurements. Use the provider conditions for reuse and redistribution.

sources.title: EUCROPMAP 2018 dataset record
sources.project_use: Crop-type mapping and crop-area masks.
sources.caveat: A historical map cannot establish a field crop or rotation in 2026.

sources.title: EUCROPMAP 2018 and 2022 catalogue
sources.project_use: Distributor documentation and class legend for the 2018/2022 maps.
sources.access: Public documentation; Earth Engine use requires its own setup
sources.caveat: Confirm crop classes before use: not every Path B crop is separately identifiable. These are not complete annual crop histories.

sources.title: GISCO NUTS statistical boundaries
sources.project_use: Regional/county geometry for aggregation and joins to official statistics.
sources.access: Public downloads subject to provider use conditions
sources.caveat: Match boundary year, NUTS level, coordinate system and statistics geography.

sources.title: GISCO local administrative units
sources.project_use: Municipality/commune geography where local aggregation is appropriate.
sources.access: Public downloads subject to provider use conditions
sources.caveat: Local boundaries do not imply local crop statistics are available.

sources.title: Global Agro-Ecological Zoning
sources.project_use: Crop suitability and production-potential context; links to GAEZ v5.
sources.caveat: Suitability and potential yield are model outputs, not observed production. Keep scenario/input-level assumptions.

sources.title: Crop water needs
sources.project_use: Reference concepts for crop stage, crop coefficient and evapotranspiration.
sources.caveat: Indicative requirements need local climate, variety, calendar and management calibration.

sources.title: ASAP downloads and crop calendars
sources.project_use: Crop-calendar reference and seasonal indicator context.
sources.caveat: Check country/crop coverage; confirm local flowering and harvest dates with agronomic knowledge.

sources.title: INS TEMPO agriculture and crop-production tables
sources.project_use: Romanian county cultivated area, harvested production and yield.
sources.access: Public portal; live interface not verified
sources.caveat: Portal reference is confirmed by Romania’s official Eurostat metadata. Direct retrieval failed here; verify table titles, units, crops and year coverage in TEMPO.

sources.title: Crop production in EU standard humidity by NUTS 2
sources.project_use: Regional comparison of crop area and production.
sources.caveat: Not county/parcel data. Check crop and year coverage, statistical flags and units.

sources.title: Crop production in EU standard humidity
sources.project_use: Romanian and EU national crop statistics.

sources.title: Crop-production metadata
sources.project_use: Units, moisture conventions and statistical comparability.
sources.caveat: Some methods and categories change from the 2025 reference year. Keep original metadata and flags.

sources.title: FAOSTAT data portal
sources.project_use: National production and trade context for local-versus-imported ingredient sourcing.
sources.caveat: Navigate to the required domain; values are not individual suppliers, contracts or current quotations.

sources.title: INRAE-CIRAD-AFZ feed-material tables
sources.project_use: Ingredient identity, composition and feed-material context.
sources.caveat: Farm-animal feed values do not establish dog/cat digestibility or suitability. Supplier specifications and species-specific assessment remain separate.

sources.title: Oats
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Distinguish whole grain, groats and processed forms.

sources.title: Barley
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Match processing and moisture basis.

sources.title: Maize
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Match grain versus flour, starch or by-products.

sources.title: Pea
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Whole peas and protein concentrates are different ingredients.

sources.title: Chickpea, kabuli type
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Variety and processing affect composition.

sources.title: Linseed, whole
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Whole seed, oil and meal need separate specifications.

sources.title: Sunflower oil
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Use oil-specific processing yield and impact allocation.

sources.title: Processed poultry proteins, protein 60–70%
sources.project_use: Composition reference for the Path B ingredient catalogue.
sources.caveat: Reference ingredient only; actual poultry material and processing must be specified.

sources.title: Nutritional guidelines for cats and dogs
sources.project_use: Species/life-stage constraints when considering ingredient substitutions.
sources.caveat: Link to the publication rather than redistributing it. This folder provides no validated complete pet-food formulation.

sources.title: Guide to good practice for safe pet food
sources.project_use: Manufacturing, handling and storage context for ingredient-quality risks.
sources.caveat: A remote-sensing risk signal is not a product safety certificate.

sources.title: ECO-ALIM feed ingredient environmental database
sources.project_use: Ingredient-level life-cycle assessment references.
sources.caveat: Check geography, system boundary, production practice, year and allocation before comparing factors.

sources.title: ECO-ALIM download form
sources.project_use: Obtain the provider database through its official form.
sources.access: Name/email/organization form and CAPTCHA; no form submitted during this review

sources.title: Environmental data methodology
sources.project_use: Interpret feed LCA values and differences between field, storage and factory boundaries.
sources.caveat: French-context and historical factors are proxies when applied to Romania; identify the proxy and its limitations.

sources.title: GLEAM tools and data
sources.project_use: Poultry supply-chain emissions and water-use methodology.
sources.access: Public documentation, data tools and model resources
sources.caveat: Livestock-system results are not automatically factors for rendered poultry protein. Specify co-product allocation and processing.

sources.title: Pet-food Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules
sources.project_use: Methodological reference for pet-food life-cycle boundaries and comparable product categories.
sources.access: Public reference; current validity must be checked
sources.caveat: The page states validity through 31 December 2025 for its February 2025 update. No later extension was verified; do not claim current PEF conformity.

sources.title: Mycotoxins
sources.project_use: Scientific context for weather-related quality risk in food/feed ingredients.
sources.caveat: Weather can support risk screening; contamination and concentration require direct evidence such as laboratory testing.
